summary.intent: Continue the CipherBox v2 rewrite kickoff: adopt the AGENTS.md-as-source-of-truth pattern from cipher-box-next, rewrite README.md and SECURITY.md for v2, and scaffold the v2 monorepo workspace (Rust crates + TS packages/apps) with a day-one CI gate, per the merged blueprint/deploy.md freeze handover.
summary.outcome: PR #616 merged after clearing two stale required-status-check entries from branch protection; the v1 codebase was then demolished per deploy.md's disposition tables and replaced with a green v2 skeleton (Cargo workspace with 4 stub crates, packages/client, apps/api and apps/web, restructured ci.yml as the day-one PR gate, dormant e2e/release workflows, pruned docker/codecov/coderabbit configs), with SECURITY.md and README.md rewritten for v2 and all changes committed across several commits.

repo: cipher-box uses `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh` for all gh CLI calls to avoid auth conflicts
GitHub branch protection can hold required status-check contexts for workflows that no longer exist, permanently blocking merges — must be removed from protection settings, not worked around in CI
zsh aborts an entire compound command on an unmatched glob (e.g. `rm ... commands/gsd-*.json` with no matches) — must isolate glob-bearing commands
ruby's YAML.load (not psych's unsafe_load_file, which lacks alias support in this environment) is the reliable local workflow-YAML validator here
landing/ is npm-managed (own package-lock.json) and not part of the pnpm workspace — converting it to pnpm requires `pnpm import`/`--ignore-workspace`, else pnpm silently operates on the repo root
deploy-landing.yml and render.yaml both needed updating in lockstep when landing's package manager changed — grep for all consumers before assuming one config file is authoritative
cipher-box now follows cipher-box-next's/yankey-beats's pattern: CLAUDE.md is just `@AGENTS.md`, with AGENTS.md as the harness-agnostic source of truth

code.finding: v2 uses single-component root release config: release-type node, include-component-in-tag false, release-as pinned to 2.0.0 with manifest at 1.0.0 (safe since release-as != manifest version, per the never-equal rule)
Adapted from GSD's ship-phase.md: GSD sub-commands mapped to /verify, /security-review, /crypto-privacy-review, /simplify; todos now file GitHub issues with dedupe instead of GSD todo tracking

workflow: When a user corrects a destructive action after the fact (ship-phase.md nuked, should've been adapted), recover via `git show <prior-commit>:<path>` rather than reconstructing from memory
Signed commits via 1Password SSH signing can hang indefinitely — use timeout-guarded commit attempts and verify with `git log` before retrying, rather than assuming failure
When restructuring CI across many workflow files, validate YAML syntax after every batch of sed/edit changes rather than batching all edits before validation
Background CI watchers should be re-kicked against the newest commit head after any push, since a watcher started against a stale head won't reflect further pushes
Do not include AI/Claude attribution footers in PR bodies for this user — only commit trailers are acceptable (saved as standing memory rule)

friction: 1Password SSH commit signing hung/wedged multiple times across the session (both in cipher-box-next and cipher-box), requiring background retry loops and eventually a one-time user-authorized --no-gpg-sign bypass
gh pr edit fails due to Projects-classic GraphQL deprecation, requiring a `gh api -X PATCH -F body=@file` workaround

Two stale required-status-check entries (release preview, verify e2e) in main's branch protection blocked merging PR #616 even though CI was fully green — root cause was the producing workflows had been deleted by the PR itself
A python script editing release-please.yml/coderabbit config raised a ValueError (substring not found) when the target block was the last entry with no trailing sibling to anchor on
Write tool repeatedly required a prior Read before editing already-modified files, adding extra round-trips
Injected a duplicate `name:` line into deploy-staging.yml due to a wrong assumption about workflow structure, caught and fixed on review
open_items: Report final CI status on PR #616's scaffold work (v2 workspace skeleton, CI restructure, SECURITY.md) once checks settle
Seed the GitHub-issues v2 milestone and build tracker, one issue per PR-sized slice from blueprint docs, per the previously agreed dependency order (crates/core first)

Begin actual v2 build in dependency order: crates/core → crates/engine+simulation harness → apps/api+contract suite → crates/wasm/packages/client/apps/web → crates/fuse/apps/desktop (with hardware gates run early in parallel) → staging cutover
FUSE-T ≥1.2.7 invalidation round-trip and overwrite-rename atomicity hardware checks (testing.md) still need to be run to validate the desktop driver decision
